periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented at approximately 45 degrees relative to the midline of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval geometry with a high length-to-width ratio along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches exhibit a pronounced downward elongation, tapering toward the rostrum to create a teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dark band shows a relatively flat U-shape across the dorsal surface.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal-lateral torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a broad cranial distance approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae are characterized by a smooth, convex, semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, sharp, dark-colored claws are clearly visible on the extended left forepaw.
